activity.notes: Philip of Alsace (Filips van de Elzas) became sole Count of Flanders after the death of his father Thierry in 1168 and ruled until his death at Acre on 1 June 1191. Earlier co-government while his father was alive is not expanded into a separate Activity in this requested Flanders representation.

sources.title: Stamboom der graven van Vlaanderen — Ghent University Open Journals
sources.citation_text: The Ghent historical genealogy lists Filips van den Elzas as Count of Flanders 1168–1191 and records his death at Acre on 1 June 1191.

sources.title: Diplomata Belgica record 8193 — Philip of Alsace
sources.citation_text: Diplomata Belgica identifies Philip of Alsace as count in the principality of Flanders in a charter scholarly-dated to 1168.
